english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of promoting something to the general public.

exampleSentences.english: The government’s popularization of electronic payments has made daily life more convenient for the public.
exampleSentences.traditional: 政府近年大力推廣電子支付，方便市民日常生活。
